requirements: Description must fit the site's format: the startup explained in 10 words or less
Submission is explicitly free ('Get your 10 words ready and submit it for free')
Real submission endpoint is https://app.10words.io/submit (linked from homepage); the batch's portal.10words.io/submission URL returned an empty shell
preparation: A ≤10-word description of the product — this is the entire pitch format
Possibly a Twitter/X account — on-site voting is tied to Twitter identity ('Voting as: @username')
workflow: Open https://app.10words.io/submit and submit the startup
Accepted entries appear in the collection and the periodic email digest (daily or weekly top picks)
watchFor: portal.10words.io/submission rendered nothing — use app.10words.io/submit instead

Site feels dormant-era (IndieHackers-inspired side project); engagement may be low
